rows.coder_note: The ARIC data are attributed to [30], the 1989 cohort design paper with no DOI, PMID or PMC id. The sentence giving 7,213 European individuals holds the cohort name and a count but no platform or year (rule I1); the SOMAmer platform is stated three sentences earlier. [20] (Zhang 2022) is cited only for the elastic-net model, in a sentence with no ancestry or N to separate its two dictionary rows (rule E).

rows.quote: The blood proteomes integrated with genotyping data were derived from the Atherosclerosis Risk in Communities (ARIC) study [30] and the INTERVAL study [21].
rows.reference_quote: Sun BB, Maranville JC, Peters JE, Stacey D, Staley JR, Blackshaw J, Burgess S, Jiang T, Paige E, Surendran P, et al. Genomic atlas of the human plasma proteome. Nature. 2018;558(7708):73–9.
rows.coder_note: The sentence attributes the INTERVAL proteome data to [21], placed directly after "the INTERVAL study"; entry 21 is Sun 2018, DOI 10.1038/s41586-018-0175-2, the source of exactly one dictionary row. The 3,301 European individuals stated later agree.
